home.welcome.heading: Welcome
home.welcome.sub: We are glad you are here.
home.welcome.body: Christ Community of Grace is a Bible-believing, gospel-centered church in Calamba, Philippines. We gather to worship God, grow in His Word, and serve one another and our community with the love of Christ. Whether you are a long-time believer or simply curious about faith, you are welcome here.
home.events.sub: Join us for worship, study, and fellowship.
home.sermon.heading: Recent Sermon
home.sermon.sub: Catch up on our latest message from God's Word.
home.sermon.auto: Our newest upload plays here automatically.
home.newhere.heading: New Here?
home.newhere.body: We would love to meet you! Whether it is your first Sunday or you are still deciding, we want you to feel at home. Find out what to expect when you visit, where we are located, and how to get connected.
newhere.title: New Here?
newhere.sub: We would love to welcome you this Sunday. Here is everything you need to know before you come.
newhere.expect.heading: What to Expect
newhere.expect.body: Our Sunday service lasts about an hour and a half. We sing together, pray together, and hear a message from the Bible that is clear and practical. You will not be singled out or asked to give. Come as you are.
newhere.expect.arrive.heading: When to arrive
newhere.expect.arrive.body: Doors open 20 minutes before the service. Arriving early gives you time to find a seat and meet a few people.
newhere.expect.wear.heading: What to wear
newhere.expect.wear.body: Whatever is comfortable. Most people dress casually or smart casual.
newhere.expect.kids.heading: Kids
newhere.expect.kids.body: Children are welcome in the service, and we have Bible lessons and activities for kids during the message. Ask any of our volunteers to show you where.
newhere.expect.lang.heading: Language
newhere.expect.lang.body: Our services are in a mix of English and Filipino, so everyone can follow along.
newhere.faq.heading: Common Questions
newhere.faq.q1: Do I need to be a member to attend?
newhere.faq.a1: No. Everyone is welcome at every service, whether you are exploring faith for the first time or have followed Jesus for years.
newhere.faq.a2: Street parking is available around the building on St. Angela Street. If you are coming by tricycle or jeepney, ask for Lakeview Phase III in Halang.
newhere.faq.a3: Yes. Our services are streamed on YouTube, and past sermons are on our Sermons page. Watching online is a great way to get a feel for who we are.
newhere.faq.a4: Introduce yourself to anyone on the welcome team after the service, join a small group, or send us a message and we will reach out to you.
newhere.hello.heading: Say Hello
newhere.hello.body: Have a question before you visit? Send us a message and someone from our team will get back to you.
about.title: About Us
about.mission.heading: Our Mission
about.mission.body: Christ Community of Grace exists to glorify God by making disciples of Jesus Christ in Calamba, Philippines and beyond. We are committed to expository preaching of the whole counsel of Scripture, genuine fellowship rooted in the gospel, and equipping every believer to live out their faith in the home, workplace, and community. We believe the local church is God's primary instrument for the transformation of lives, and we are humbled to be part of His work here in the heart of Laguna.
about.faith.heading: Statement of Faith
about.faith.bible.title: The Bible
about.faith.bible.body: We believe the Bible, both the Old and New Testaments, is the inspired, inerrant, and infallible Word of God. It is the supreme and final authority in all matters of faith and practice. Written by human authors under the supernatural guidance of the Holy Spirit, Scripture is fully trustworthy and sufficient to equip every believer for every good work (2 Timothy 3:16–17).
about.faith.god.title: God
about.faith.god.body: We believe in one eternal, sovereign God who exists as three distinct Persons, Father, Son, and Holy Spirit, co-equal and co-eternal, sharing the same divine nature and glory. God is holy, just, loving, and all-powerful. He is the Creator and Sustainer of all things, and He works all things according to the counsel of His perfect will (Deuteronomy 6:4; Matthew 28:19; 2 Corinthians 13:14).
about.faith.salvation.title: Salvation
about.faith.salvation.body: We believe that all people are sinners by nature and by choice, and are in need of God's saving grace. Salvation is entirely the work of God, given by grace alone, through faith alone, in Christ alone. Jesus Christ, the eternal Son of God, became flesh, lived a sinless life, died as the atoning sacrifice for sin, and rose bodily from the dead. All who repent and trust in Him receive forgiveness, righteousness, and eternal life (Ephesians 2:8–9; Romans 3:23–24; John 3:16).
about.faith.church.title: The Church
about.faith.church.body: We believe the church is the body of Christ, a community of redeemed believers who have been called out of the world to worship God, build one another up in love, and bear witness to the gospel. The local church gathers regularly for the preaching of the Word, the practice of the ordinances (baptism and the Lord's Supper), prayer, and fellowship. Every believer is gifted by the Spirit for service within the body and the world (Matthew 16:18; Ephesians 4:11–16; Acts 2:42–47).
about.faith.return.title: The Return of Christ
about.faith.return.body: We believe in the personal, bodily, and glorious return of Jesus Christ. He will come again to consummate His kingdom, judge the living and the dead, and make all things new. Believers await His return with hope and expectancy, living faithfully in the present age. Those who are in Christ will enjoy eternal life in His presence, while those who have rejected Him will face eternal judgment (Acts 1:11; 1 Thessalonians 4:16–17; Revelation 21:1–5).
about.leaders.heading: Our Leadership
about.leaders.bio1: Pastor Name has served Christ Community of Grace since its founding, faithfully proclaiming the gospel and shepherding the congregation with wisdom and care.
about.leaders.bio2: Elder Name provides spiritual oversight and biblical counsel to the congregation, dedicated to prayer, the ministry of the Word, and the care of every member.
about.leaders.bio3: Deacon Name serves the practical and administrative needs of the church with a joyful heart, reflecting the servant leadership of Christ.

ministries.sub: There is a place for you to grow and serve.
ministries.small.title: Small Groups
ministries.small.body: Join a small group for deeper fellowship and Bible study. Our groups meet weekly in homes across Calamba.
ministries.youth.title: Youth Ministry
ministries.youth.body: A Christ-centered community for teens to grow in faith, build friendships, and serve together.
ministries.children.title: Children's Ministry
ministries.children.body: Fun, safe, and Bible-focused programs for kids to learn about God's love and grow in faith.
ministries.men.title: Men's Ministry
ministries.men.body: Equipping men to be godly leaders through Bible study, accountability, and fellowship.
ministries.women.title: Women's Ministry
ministries.women.body: A supportive community where women encourage one another through Scripture, prayer, and fellowship.
ministries.worship.title: Worship Team
ministries.worship.body: Using music and art to lead our congregation in heartfelt worship every Sunday.
